# Donation Widget Frontend Development Instructions

## Overview

You are developing a secure, accessible donation widget using React/Preact with TypeScript. The widget integrates with GP Webpay payment gateway through a serverless Lambda backend. Follow these guidelines for optimal security, accessibility, and user experience.

## Architecture Principles

### Component Structure
- **Modular Design**: Each component should have a single responsibility
- **Reusable Components**: Create composable UI elements with proper TypeScript interfaces
- **CSS Modules**: Use scoped styling to prevent style conflicts
- **Context API**: Manage global state (translations, theme) through React Context
- **Error Boundaries**: Implement error boundaries for payment-related components

### Security-First Frontend
- **Input Validation**: Validate all user inputs on frontend before sending to backend
- **XSS Prevention**: Use proper escaping and avoid innerHTML with user data
- **HTTPS Enforcement**: All API calls must use HTTPS endpoints
- **Token Security**: Never store sensitive payment data in frontend state or localStorage
- **CSP Headers**: Content Security Policy headers should be configured on hosting

## Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) Requirements

### Form Accessibility
```jsx
// Always provide proper labels and descriptions
<label htmlFor="amount-input" className="sr-only">
  Donation Amount in {currency}
</label>
<input
  id="amount-input"
  type="number"
  min={minAmount}
  max={maxAmount}
  aria-describedby="amount-help"

  aria-invalid={hasError}
```

### Error Handling Accessibility
```jsx
// Announce errors to screen readers
<div 
  role="alert" 
  aria-live="polite"
  className={`error-message ${isVisible ? 'visible' : 'sr-only'}`}
>
  {errorMessage}
</div>
```

### Keyboard Navigation
- All interactive elements must be keyboard accessible
- Logical tab order through the donation flow
- Custom components must handle Enter and Space key events
- Focus management for modal dialogs and form submission

### Color and Contrast
- Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text
- Minimum 3:1 contrast ratio for large text and UI components
- Don't rely solely on color to convey information
- Provide text alternatives for color-coded status indicators

## Input Validation & Security

### Amount Validation
```typescript
const validateDonationAmount = (amount: number, currency: string): ValidationResult => {
  const limits = {
    CZK: { min: 50, max: 500000 }, // 50 CZK to 500,000 CZK
    EUR: { min: 2, max: 20000 },   // 2 EUR to 20,000 EUR
    USD: { min: 2, max: 25000 }    // 2 USD to 25,000 USD
  };
  
  const { min, max } = limits[currency];
  
  if (!amount || amount < min) {
    return { isValid: false, error: `Minimum donation is ${min} ${currency}` };
  }
  
  if (amount > max) {
    return { isValid: false, error: `Maximum donation is ${max} ${currency}` };
  }
  
  // Check for reasonable decimal places
  const decimals = (amount.toString().split('.')[1] || '').length;
  if (decimals > 2) {
    return { isValid: false, error: 'Please enter amount with maximum 2 decimal places' };
  }
  
  return { isValid: true };
};
```

### Email Validation
```typescript
const validateEmail = (email: string): boolean => {
  // RFC 5322 compliant email validation
  const emailRegex = /^[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?(?:\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*$/;
  return emailRegex.test(email);
};
```

### Input Sanitization
```typescript
const sanitizeInput = (input: string): string => {
  // Remove potentially harmful characters
  return input
    .replace(/[<>"/]/g, '') // Remove HTML/script injection chars
    .replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '') // Trim whitespace
    .substring(0, 255); // Limit length
};
```

## State Management

### Form State Interface
```typescript
interface DonationFormState {
  // Payment details
  amount: number | null;
  currency: 'CZK' | 'EUR' | 'USD';
  isCustomAmount: boolean;
  
  // Donor information
  donor: {
    firstName: string;
    lastName: string;
    email: string;
    phone: string;
    isAnonymous: boolean;
  };
  
  // UI state
  isSubmitting: boolean;
  errors: Record<string, string>;
  currentStep: 'amount' | 'donor' | 'payment' | 'success';
  
  // Payment processing
  paymentUrl: string | null;
  orderNumber: string | null;
}
```

### Form Validation Hook
```typescript
const useFormValidation = (formData: DonationFormState) => {
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  
  const validateForm = useCallback((): boolean => {
    const newErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
    
    // Amount validation
    if (!formData.amount) {
      newErrors.amount = t('validation.required');
    } else {
      const amountValidation = validateDonationAmount(formData.amount, formData.currency);
      if (!amountValidation.isValid) {
        newErrors.amount = amountValidation.error;
      }
    }
    
    // Donor validation (if not anonymous)
    if (!formData.donor.isAnonymous) {
      if (!formData.donor.firstName.trim()) {
        newErrors.firstName = t('validation.required');
      }
      if (!formData.donor.lastName.trim()) {
        newErrors.lastName = t('validation.required');
      }
      if (!formData.donor.email.trim()) {
        newErrors.email = t('validation.required');
      } else if (!validateEmail(formData.donor.email)) {
        newErrors.email = t('validation.email');
      }
    }
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  }, [formData, t]);
  
  return { errors, validateForm };
};
```

## Payment Integration

### API Communication
```typescript
interface PaymentResponse {
  success: boolean;
  paymentUrl?: string;
  orderNumber?: string;
  error?: string;
  details?: string;
}

const initiatePayment = async (formData: DonationFormState): Promise<PaymentResponse> => {
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/api/payment/create', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Accept': 'application/json'
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        amount: Math.round(formData.amount * 100), // Convert to cents
        currency: formData.currency,
        donor: formData.donor.isAnonymous ? null : formData.donor,
        language: getCurrentLanguage(),
        returnUrl: window.location.origin + '/payment-result'
      })
    });
    
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
    }
    
    return await response.json();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Payment initiation failed:', error);
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'Payment initiation failed',
      details: error.message
    };
  }
};
```

### Payment Flow Management
```typescript
const handlePaymentSubmit = async (formData: DonationFormState) => {
  setIsSubmitting(true);
  
  try {
    // Validate form data
    if (!validateForm()) {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
      return;
    }
    
    // Initiate payment
    const paymentResponse = await initiatePayment(formData);
    
    if (paymentResponse.success && paymentResponse.paymentUrl) {
      // Redirect to GP Webpay
      window.location.href = paymentResponse.paymentUrl;
    } else {
      // Handle payment initiation error
      setErrors({ submit: paymentResponse.error || 'Payment failed' });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    setErrors({ submit: 'An unexpected error occurred' });
  } finally {
    setIsSubmitting(false);
  }
};
```

## Error Handling & User Feedback

### Error Display Component
```jsx
const ErrorDisplay = ({ error, onRetry }) => (
  <div className="error-container" role="alert">
    <div className="error-icon" aria-hidden="true">⚠️</div>
    <div className="error-content">
      <h3 className="error-title">{t('error.title')}</h3>
      <p className="error-message">{error}</p>
      {onRetry && (
        <button 
          type="button" 
          className="retry-button"
          onClick={onRetry}
        >
          {t('error.retry')}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  </div>
);
```

### Loading States
```jsx
const SubmitButton = ({ isSubmitting, amount, currency }) => (
  <button 
    type="submit" 
    disabled={isSubmitting}
    className={`submit-button ${isSubmitting ? 'submitting' : ''}`}
    aria-describedby={isSubmitting ? 'submit-status' : undefined}
  >
    {isSubmitting ? (
      <>
        <span className="spinner" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span>{t('payment.processing')}</span>
      </>
    ) : (
      t('payment.submit', { amount, currency })
    )}
  </button>
);
```

## Performance Optimization

### Code Splitting
```typescript
// Lazy load heavy components
const PaymentResult = lazy(() => import('./components/PaymentResult'));
const DonorForm = lazy(() => import('./components/DonorForm'));

// Use Suspense with fallback
<Suspense fallback={<LoadingSpinner />}>
  <PaymentResult />
</Suspense>
```

### Bundle Optimization
- Use tree shaking for imports
- Minimize CSS bundle size with CSS Modules
- Optimize images and icons (SVG preferred)
- Implement proper caching headers

### Runtime Performance
```typescript
// Memoize expensive calculations
const formattedAmount = useMemo(() => {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat(getCurrentLocale(), {
    style: 'currency',
    currency: currency
  }).format(amount);
}, [amount, currency, getCurrentLocale]);

// Debounce user input
const debouncedValidation = useMemo(
  () => debounce(validateForm, 300),
  [validateForm]
);
```

## Testing Guidelines

### Component Testing
```typescript
// Test donation amount validation
describe('DonationAmount', () => {
  it('should validate minimum amount correctly', () => {
    render(<DonationAmount currency="CZK" />);
    
    const input = screen.getByLabelText(/donation amount/i);
    fireEvent.change(input, { target: { value: '10' } });
    fireEvent.blur(input);
    
    expect(screen.getByText(/minimum donation is 50 CZK/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  
  it('should be accessible with screen reader', async () => {
    const { container } = render(<DonationAmount currency="EUR" />);
    const results = await axe(container);
    expect(results).toHaveNoViolations();
  });
});
```

### Integration Testing
```typescript
// Test complete donation flow
describe('Donation Flow', () => {
  it('should complete donation process successfully', async () => {
    const mockPaymentResponse = {
      success: true,
      paymentUrl: 'https://test.gpwebpay.com/payment/12345',
      orderNumber: 'ORD123456'
    };
    
    fetchMock.post('/api/payment/create', mockPaymentResponse);
    
    render(<DonationForm />);
    
    // Fill donation amount
    const amountInput = screen.getByLabelText(/donation amount/i);
    fireEvent.change(amountInput, { target: { value: '100' } });
    
    // Fill donor information
    const emailInput = screen.getByLabelText(/email/i);
    fireEvent.change(emailInput, { target: { value: 'test@example.com' } });
    
    // Submit form

    fireEvent.click(submitButton);
    
    // Verify API call

      expect(fetchMock.lastCall()[1].body).toContain('"amount":10000');
```

## Deployment Considerations

### Build Configuration
- Enable production optimizations in Vite/webpack
- Configure proper source maps for debugging
- Set up environment-specific configuration
- Implement proper error reporting

### Security Headers
```javascript
// Required security headers for hosting
const securityHeaders = {
  'Content-Security-Policy': "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' https://api.gpwebpay.com",
  'X-Frame-Options': 'DENY',
  'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff',
  'Referrer-Policy': 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin',
  'Strict-Transport-Security': 'max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains'
};
```

Remember: Always test the complete donation flow in GP Webpay test environment before production deployment, including all error scenarios and edge cases.
